Plan: dark-mode toggle done

People choose System, Light or Dark in Settings, and every page opens in that theme from the first frame.

Control flow: one checkpoint review after P-1 (shared contract), then the end review · QA up to 3 rounds with a verifier, desktop and phone, light and dark, checked against the approved mockup. Approved as D-3.

In three sentences

We add an Appearance row to Settings with System, Light and Dark (SC-1). The choice is kept in browser storage and applied by a tiny script in the page head before anything paints (SC-2, SC-3). The user gets a dark app at night that stays dark after a reload, with no white flash.

Deferred

ItemWhyRevisit when
Account sync of the themeNeeds a server fieldPeople ask for it across devices

Scope

Dark values for every colour token, the theme store, the boot script, and the Appearance row in Settings.

Constraints

Existing tokens only; no new dependencies; 4.5:1 text contrast in both themes.

Non-goals

Account sync; custom accents; any restyle beyond dark values.

Ask-first actions

Renaming any existing token, or changing the light values.

Cross-cutting

ConcernPlan
Securityn/a because nothing new is sent or received; the stored value is checked against three allowed strings.
Privacyn/a because the theme stays on the device.
Observabilityn/a because a theme change has no server side.
Migration and rollbackAddressed in P-1: no stored value means System, so rollback leaves a harmless key behind.
PerformanceAddressed in P-1: the boot script is under 1 KB and inline, so it adds no request.

How we will know it works

J-1 · pick Dark in Settings covers SC-1 · P-2

Given Settings is open and the theme is Light
When the person picks Dark in the Appearance control
Then the whole app turns dark at once, with no reload, and Dark shows as selected
Continues to the other Settings rows keep their values and layout
Check app: screenshots of Settings before and after, desktop and phone, light and dark

J-2 · reload keeps Dark covers SC-2 · SC-3 · P-1

Given the person picked Dark earlier
When they reload any page
Then the page paints dark from the first frame and Settings still shows Dark
Check app: screenshot of the first painted frame after reload, plus Settings after reload

S-1 · theme tests covers SC-2 · P-1

Run npm test -- theme → expect the theme store and boot script tests pass, including the storage-blocked case.

Packages

P-1 · Theme store and boot script

Outcome The app reads and writes the theme choice and sets data-theme on the root element before first paint. Dark values exist for every colour token.

Labels: shared-contract · Depends on: nothing · Rollback: delete the key handling; a stored key is ignored

Approach

Add src/theme/store.ts with getTheme, setTheme and subscribe. Add a short inline script to index.html that reads notebook.theme and resolves System through the device preference. Add a dark block to src/styles/tokens.css keyed on [data-theme="dark"].

P-2 · Appearance control in Settings

Outcome Settings shows the segmented control from the approved mockup and applies a choice at once.

Labels: ui · Depends on: P-1

Approach

Add src/settings/ThemeControl.tsx using the existing button group styles, with a check mark on the selected segment and a visible focus ring in both themes.
